description: This file contains partial class and method definitions related to the Orleans framework extensions and Cosmos DB configurations for reminders. It includes extension methods for setting up Cosmos reminder services, Cosmos options with configuration methods, an options validator, and an interface for executing Cosmos operations.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Abstract class providing configuration properties and methods for setting up Cosmos DB reminder storage, including client options, resource management, and operation execution.

classes.name: CosmosOptionsValidator<TOptions>
classes.description: Validator class for CosmosOptions, ensuring configuration correctness.

classes.name: CosmosReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Concrete class inheriting from CosmosOptions, specifically for Cosmos DB Reminder Table settings.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining method for executing Cosmos DB operations asynchronously.

methods.name: UseCosmosReminderService
methods.description: Extension methods to add Cosmos Reminder Service to dependency injection or silo builder.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Methods to configure the Cosmos DB client using various credential options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method to validate the CosmosOptions configuration.
